title: Abilities tuning
description: Gameplay tuning owned by the Abilities domain: the statuses abilities apply and each ability's numbers, keyed by content ID and grouped by archetype (ADR-008 §3). VeyraAbilities binds it to FVeyraAbilitiesTuning. A list whose name ends "ByRank" holds one value for every rank, or one value per rank.

byRank.description: One value for every rank, or one value per rank (5 for a basic ability, 3 for an ultimate).

cast.description: How a cast is timed and paid for (Combat Bible §26, §27, §48; ADR-008 §4).

cooldownSecondsByRank.description: Cooldown in seconds, starting at Commit.

castRange.description: How far from the caster the cast's ground point may be, in units; a point beyond it is brought back within it (ADR-008 §9). 0 for an ability that needs no point.

windupSeconds.description: Seconds before Commit. An interruption during them costs nothing and starts part of the cooldown (Combat Bible §26).

windupMovement.description: Whether the caster may move during the windup (Combat Bible §48).

recoverySeconds.description: Seconds after delivery before the caster may cast again.

recastWindow.description: At most one: the follow-up its slot holds once this cast commits, for a while (ADR-018 §1). Empty for none.
A recast window: the slot holds another ability until it is cast or its time runs out (ADR-018 §1).

onExpiry.description: Lapse loses the follow-up; Cast casts it where the caster faces.

damage.description: One damage component: its amount at the caster's rank plus the caster's power times the ratios, fixed at Commit (Combat Bible §25, §50).

displacement.description: A Knockback or Pull of each unit hit (Combat Bible §9). Displacement Resistance shortens it.

direction.description: TowardOrigin pulls toward the area's origin or the caster; AwayFromOrigin knocks back from it; AcrossCastLeft and AcrossCastRight push sideways to the cast; AsideFromPath pushes out of a projectile's path.

distance.description: Units; a Pull toward the origin stops there.

effects.description: What happens to each unit hit.

missingHealthDamage.description: At most one, beside damage: damage for the Health the target already lacks, read when the hit lands and joining its component of that type (Combat Bible §50).

unitKindMultipliers.description: Damage multiplied against some kinds of unit, at least 1, once per kind, never structures (ADR-018 §6).

displacementUnlessStatuses.description: Statuses that spare a unit this displacement: one displacement per target per cast (Roster Bible §1).

zone.description: One zone of an area: its shape and what it does to each enemy in it.

casterShieldPerVanguard.description: At most one: a shield the caster gains once for each enemy Vanguard the zone catches, such as an ultimate's per-target shield.

casterStatusesPerVanguard.description: Statuses the caster gains for each enemy Vanguard the zone catches, such as the state an ultimate enters when it lands on a Vanguard (No Quarter; ADR-008 §9).

shield.description: A shield granted to the caster (Combat Bible §7, §51; ADR-009 §3): the rank's amount plus the caster's Max Health and Magic Power times the ratios.

id.description: The shield's identity: a new grant meets an active shield with it from the same caster as reapply says.

maxHealthRatio.description: Of the caster's Max Health, added to the amount.

reapply.description: Replace: a new grant starts the shield again. Merge: it adds to what is left, up to the maximum, and restarts the duration.

maxAmountMaxHealthRatio.description: The most a merged shield holds, as a fraction of the caster's Max Health; never less than one grant.

capGroup.description: At most one: a group whose shields from this caster together hold at most a share of its Max Health, such as Cairn's passive and ultimate shields.

shape.description: A hit shape (ADR-009 §4). Each kind uses its own sizes; the others are 0.

arcDegrees.description: Sector: the whole angle, in degrees.

length.description: Rectangle: along the cast's direction, in units.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this file's format. A build reads exactly one version.

interruptedCooldownFraction.description: The part of its cooldown a cast starts when it is interrupted before Commit (Combat Bible §26).

statuses.description: Statuses abilities apply, keyed by their stable ID (Combat Bible §8, §46).

magnitude.description: Read as the kind says (EVeyraStatusKind): 0 for a Stun, the fraction of speed removed for a Slow, a signed change for Move Speed and Attack Speed, one tick's damage at its source's first Level for DamageOverTime, the fraction removed for the others.

durationSeconds.description: Before Tenacity, which shortens crowd control only.

takedownExtensionSeconds.description: Seconds each takedown adds; 0 for none.

takedownExtensionMaxSeconds.description: The most takedowns add in all.

damageOverTime.description: How a DamageOverTime status ticks (Combat Bible §14): one entry for that kind, none for any other.

tickSeconds.description: Seconds between ticks; the first comes this long after it lands.

damagePerLevel.description: Added to each tick for each Level of its source's beyond the first, fixed as it lands.

stackDecaySeconds.description: For a stacking status: once its duration runs out it loses one stack and lasts this long again, until the last stack goes (ADR-018 §2). 0 to end at once.

arcDegrees.description: DirectionalDamageReduction: the arc of the unit's facing it guards, in degrees; 0 for any other kind.

unitKinds.description: AttackDamageAmplification: the unit kinds it amplifies attacks against (EVeyraUnitKind), empty for all; empty for any other kind.

targetedDamage.description: Abilities cast at one enemy that resolve at once and deal one damage component and may put statuses on it (Combat Bible §29 targeted, instant; ADR-015 §3). test_bolt is the developer test ability (ADR-006 M3); its values are provisional.

castRange.description: Cast range in units, measured edge to edge (Combat Bible §40).

cooldownSeconds.description: Cooldown in seconds, starting at Commit (Combat Bible §26).

damageAmount.description: Raw damage before any modifier (Combat Bible §25, step 2), at the caster's first Level; 0 for an ability that only applies statuses.

damagePerLevel.description: Added for each Level of the caster's beyond the first, read at Commit.

statuses.description: Put on the target it hits.

targetKinds.description: The kinds of unit it may target (EVeyraUnitKind); empty for any hostile unit. Never Structure (Combat Bible §33).

area.description: Abilities that hit the enemies in shapes at the caster or a ground point, at once, after a delay, or in channel ticks (ADR-008 §3).

origin.description: Caster: on the caster, facing the cast's point. TargetPoint: on the point, facing away from the caster.

delaySeconds.description: Seconds between Commit and the hit, with the area telegraphed; the caster is free meanwhile.

channelTicks.description: How many times the area hits over channelSeconds, the caster held in place.

reveal.description: Ordinary vision the area lights for its caster's side as it commits, which over Dense Fog reports presence instead (ADR-016 §5), as Sounding Flare's; 0 and 0 for none.

zones.description: Innermost first: a unit takes the first zone that touches it, and no other.

linger.description: At most one: after it hits at once, the area lasts in its outermost zone's shape, giving those inside it statuses by side (ADR-018 §5), as Kade's Sightline does.

pulseSeconds.description: Seconds between the statuses it gives; it gives them first as it lands.

allyStatuses.description: For the allied Vanguards inside, its caster apart.

sight.description: Ordinary: its shape is ordinary vision for its caster's side while it lasts, never True Sight and nothing in Dense Fog.

consumesCasterStatuses.description: Statuses the caster loses as it commits, whatever their stacks, as Break the Line spends Cadence (ADR-018 §6).

channelMovement.description: Locked holds the caster in place while it channels; Free lets it move, each tick placed where it stands (ADR-018 §6).

casterStatuses.description: Put on the caster as it commits.

healOnHit.description: At most one: Health the caster restores from the units it hits, capped for the cast (ADR-018 §6).

selfBuff.description: Abilities that buff their caster, and optionally nearby allied Vanguards (ADR-008 §3).

shields.description: At most one shield on the caster (Combat Bible §7).

aura.description: At most one aura of statuses for nearby allied Vanguards (ADR-008 §9).

radius.description: Units from the caster's centre to an ally's edge.

refreshSeconds.description: How often allies in range get the statuses again; the statuses should outlast it.

enemyStatuses.description: Put on each living enemy unit in range at every refresh, never a structure or a ward (ADR-018 §6).

heal.description: At most one heal for the caster and its most wounded allied Vanguard in range (ADR-015 §3), never above Max Health.

amount.description: Health restored at the caster's first Level.

amountPerLevel.description: Added for each Level of the caster's beyond the first.

allyRange.description: Units from the caster's centre to an ally's edge; 0 heals the caster alone.

statuses.description: Put on each unit it heals.

recast.description: EndsEarly: casting again while the buff lasts ends it, at no cost.

variants.description: Slots that hold another ability for a while as the buff lands (ADR-018 §1), as Dig In's volley form during The Last Volley. A variant takes its slot's rank.

slot.description: Q, W, E or R: a basic ability's slot or the ultimate's.

cooldown.description: Own keeps its own cooldown; Shared is one cooldown with the slot's own ability.

temporaryHealth.description: At most one: Temporary Health for its caster (Combat Bible §7; ADR-018 §6).

maxHealthRatio.description: And this share of the caster's Max Health.

endPayload.description: At most one: as the buff ends, a status on each enemy unit near its caster, lasting longer for each hit the caster took meanwhile (ADR-018 §6).

afterSeconds.description: When it comes, in seconds after the cast.

radius.description: Units from the caster's centre to an enemy's edge.

status.description: A status ID from the statuses map.

minHits.description: The hits the caster must take for it to come at all; 0 for always.

skillshot.description: Abilities that fire a line projectile toward the cast's point; terrain stops it (ADR-008 §3, §9).

radius.description: The projectile's own radius: it hits a unit whose body it touches.

range.description: How far it flies before it ends, in units.

collision.description: FirstEnemy: the first enemy unit stops it. FirstEnemyVanguard: only an enemy Vanguard stops it; it passes through other enemies. Pierce: nothing stops it but terrain and its range.

passThroughEffects.description: On each unit a FirstEnemyVanguard projectile passes through; empty lists otherwise.

casterDash.description: At most one: the caster recoils away from the aim as the shot leaves (ADR-018 §6), as Kade's Reposition does.

dash.description: Abilities that move their caster, with effects as it sets off and where it stops (ADR-008 §3; Combat Bible §9). Displacement interrupts a dash; terrain stops it.

direction.description: TowardPoint: toward the cast's point. AwayFromPoint: straight back from it, as a recoil. AwayFromHost: straight back from the unit the caster holds on to, letting go (ADR-018 §2).

distance.description: Units; terrain stops the dash sooner.

contact.description: StopAtFirstEnemy: the dash ends at the first enemy it meets, which takes the contact effects.

startZones.description: Areas at the caster, facing the cast's point, as the dash sets off; innermost first.

contactEffects.description: On the enemy a StopAtFirstEnemy dash stops at.

contactSelfStatuses.description: Put on the caster when it stops at an enemy.

hostEffects.description: On the unit an AwayFromHost dash lets go of, as the throw's stumble; no effects for any other dash.

endZones.description: Areas at the caster, facing the cast's point, as the dash sets off; innermost first.

rideExit.description: Stay: it rides on, if it rides. Leave: it separates rider and vehicle first, as Bail Out and Last Exit do (Combat Bible §56).

empoweredAttack.description: Abilities that empower the caster's next basic attack, which stays a basic attack (ADR-008 §3; Combat Bible §17).

durationSeconds.description: How long the empowerment waits for an attack.

damage.description: Joins the attack's own damage event, so the empowered attack is still one hit.

armorPenetrationByRank.description: The fraction of the target's Armor the attack ignores, at most 1: percentage penetration (Combat Bible §3).

cleave.description: At most one: the other enemies in the attacker's cleave shape take part of the attack's damage.

secondaryImpact.description: At most one: proc damage in a shape behind the target, excluding it. The attack keeps the highest-priority impact offered, such as over a passive's (ADR-009 §5).

volley.description: Abilities that open a lane their caster fires into shot by shot (ADR-018 §6), as Kade's Kill Corridor: the slot holds the shot for a while, and each shot keeps within the lane.

shot.description: Each shot: a skillshot, whose cooldown is the time between shots.

laneHalfAngleDegrees.description: How far either side of the lane a shot may aim.

casterStatuses.description: For the caster while the lane lasts, as a stance that plants it.

bonus.description: At most one: an ally displacing an enemy that carries status from the caster earns a shot, up to maxShots.

tether.description: Abilities that tether an enemy to their caster (Combat Bible §43; ADR-018), as Patch's Don't Leave Me: the caster's side sees the target while it holds; stretched beyond its range, it may snap the target back once, and ends.

targetKinds.description: The kinds of unit it may target (EVeyraUnitKind); empty for any hostile unit. Never Structure (Combat Bible §33).

maxRange.description: Edge to edge, in units; beyond it the tether stretches. At least the cast's range.

snapDistance.description: Stretched, the pull toward the caster, in units before Displacement Resistance; 0 for none.

snapSpeed.description: The pull's units per second: above 0 with a pull, 0 without.

targetStatuses.description: Held on the target while the tether lasts.

attach.description: Abilities that leap their caster at an enemy and hold on to it (ADR-018 §2), as Patch's Bear Hug: ending within reach, the caster attaches for a while and the host takes the host effects and holds the host statuses; out of reach, nothing more happens.

targetKinds.description: The kinds of unit it may target (EVeyraUnitKind); empty for any hostile unit. Never Structure (Combat Bible §33).

reachOnArrival.description: Edge to edge, in units, how near the target must be as the leap ends for the caster to take hold.

hostStatuses.description: Held on the host while the caster holds on.

hostEffects.description: On the host as the caster takes hold.

ride.description: Abilities that put their caster in a ride state (Combat Bible §56; ADR-018 §7), as Raska's Kickstart and NO BRAKES: a set speed and a limited turn rate, mounted actions in their slots, statuses held meanwhile, and a vehicle that goes on without its rider as the ride ends.

setSpeed.description: The rider's Movement Speed, set rather than added.

decaySeconds.description: Seconds over which the rider slows back to its ordinary speed after.

riderStatuses.description: Held on the rider while it rides.

mounted.description: The mounted actions, one per basic ability's slot.

vehicle.description: At most one: the skillshot its vehicle goes on as along the rider's heading as the ride ends.

fluxSpells.description: The Flux Spells a player may put in a spell slot (Battleground Bible §14; ADR-015 §3): ordinary abilities of the maps above, each with one value for every rank.
